'''Ep Gart''' was a brash, small-time criminal based out of [[Mos Zabu/Legends|Mos Zabu]], on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Planning to sell a load of [[Nergon-14/Legends|Nergon-14]] to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officer, his plans were thwarted when [[Domo Jones]] and his associate [[Blerx Tango|Blerx]] caused a herd of [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]] to stampede the location of the sale. Gart was killed when he tried to catch Domo, only to find himself flying into the gaping mouth of a [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] in the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Sarlacc fields]].
